framework_rationale: The board faces a yes/no on a proposal whose number is wrong: Situation (claim), Complication (overstated base and unpriced single-plant risk), Resolution (options compared on one basis, then a gated approval). Problem comes before solution.

candidates.text: Approve full consolidation on Supplier B, but at an expected saving of about €3.8M over 2026-2028 (€1.27M a year), not the €9.0M claimed, and sign only once a continuity safeguard covers its single plant
Reject the proposal: the single-plant risk outweighs a saving far smaller than claimed; keep a 70/30 split
Approve the proposal as submitted: €3.0M a year from a 12% price reduction

governing_thought: Approve full consolidation on Supplier B, but at an expected saving of about €3.8M over 2026-2028 (€1.27M a year), not the €9.0M claimed, and sign only once a continuity safeguard covers its single plant

key_line.message: The €3.0M a year claim is overstated: the 12% applies to €23.9M, not €25M, and the case omits switching cost and stoppage risk
Supplier B's single plant is the largest cost in the case: a repeat of its two stoppages costs €4.0M over three years at full exposure, and it hits every option by its Supplier B share
On the same basis full consolidation still wins: €3.8M net over three years against €2.08M for 70/30 and a €1.2M net cost for the status quo, and it stays ahead unless stoppages cost 2.4x history
Approve full consolidation with the budget restated to €3.8M and the three-year commitment gated on a continuity safeguard

target.note: Saving claimed by procurement over 2026-2028 (3.0 EUR M a year)

levers.statement: 12% price reduction on the 23.9 EUR M spend excluding rush freight, three years
levers.validate: Confirm in the contract that the 12% applies to all SKUs at 2025 volumes (A004)

levers.statement: One-off switching cost (tooling and line qualification) for a full move
levers.validate: Tooling quote and qualification plan before signing

levers.statement: Expected Supplier B stoppage cost at full exposure if the last three years recur
levers.validate: Plant risk audit of Supplier B and force-majeure clause before signing (A001, A002); break-even is €9.76M over three years

gap.how_closed: Not closable: it is an overstatement, not a shortfall. About €0.4M comes from applying the 12% to rush freight for three years, €0.8M from omitted switching cost and €4.0M from unpriced stoppage risk. The budget is restated to €3.8M; rush freight (€1.1M a year, our own forecast errors) is a separate lever outside this decision.

current_plan.statement: Procurement proposal: move 100% of packaging to Supplier B from January 2026, saving 3.0 EUR M a year
current_plan.note: The direction holds (best option on expected value); the number does not: booking €9.0M leaves a €5.2M hole over three years

options.statement: 70% Supplier B / 30% incumbent (9% from Supplier B, 4% from incumbent)

decision.options_note: Cost = three-year net cost over 2026-2028 (negative = net saving) = price_saving + switching + stoppage_risk, the same three components for every option. Stoppage risk is charged to every option in proportion to its Supplier B share (A002). Rush freight (€1.1M a year) is identical in all options and excluded.

asks.statement: Approve moving all packaging volume to Supplier B from 2026, subject to the continuity gate
Restate the 2026-2028 budgeted saving from €9.0M to €3.8M (€1.27M a year)
Reject the €3.0M a year figure as the basis of the business case
Negotiate a continuity safeguard (force-majeure compensation or safety stock at Supplier B, standby agreement with the incumbent) before signing the three-year commitment

gates.statement: Continuity gate before signing the three-year commitment
gates.criterion: A contractual safeguard covers a stoppage of at least 14 days; if none is obtainable, fall back to 70/30 (O2), which keeps the incumbent's two plants
If the Supplier B plant audit points to three-year stoppage exposure above €9.76M, switch to 70/30
gates.when: With the plant audit, before signature

kpis.name: Supplier B stoppage days not covered
